current.heading: Current plan
current.cancelNote: Your pending subscription request will be cancelled. You can request again anytime.

plans.comparisonHint: Pick an upgrade to unlock more quota. Payment is by bank transfer, confirmed manually by the university.

toast.requested: Subscription requested. Please follow the payment instructions.

errors.conflictBody: You already have a pending or active subscription.
errors.audienceMismatch: This plan doesn't apply to your account type.
